sum: Jasper Therapeutics, Inc., a clinical stage biotechnology company, focuses on the design and development of therapies to treat immune-mediated diseases. It is advancing a pipeline of medicines, including KP-104, a dual-complement inhibitor that has demonstrated positive outcomes in paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria (PNH) and is under evaluation in other unmet need nephrology disorders; Briquilimab is an anti-KIT antibody, which has demonstrated clinical results as a conditioning agent for stem cell transplant and mast cell mediated diseases, such as chronic urticarias and allergic asthma; and KP-701, a novel, dual-acting anti-CD79BxCD32B monoclonal antibody (mAb) for autoantibody-mediated disorders. The company is based in Redwood City, California.
